tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search documentation pages using keywords against page title, relative path, and first-paragraph summary in the lightweight static search index. Returns matching page titles, paths, and summaries.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Live operational status and network health from `GET /v1/status`. Confirm chain `status` is 'ok' before calling methods; see `list_chains` for static chain capabilities and method policies. For Data API, `data_status` can be 'ok', 'syncing' (queryable and billed normally, but indexing is lagging beh

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Live prices and plan limits from `GET /v1/plans`. Use before estimating cost or when asked about free credits, rate limits or per-method prices. Units: 1 billing unit = `pricing.cu_per_unit` CU; 1 USD buys `pricing.units_per_usd` units. `method_weights` is CU per call; resolve a method by exact matc

tools.name: estimate_usage
tools.description: Estimate daily and cycle Compute Units (CU) and USD cost for one or more methods and daily call volumes based on /v1/plans method weights and pricing. Pass 'lines' array of {method, calls_per_day}, or legacy single 'method' and 'calls_per_day'.

tools.name: how_to_get_api_key
tools.description: Get instructions and endpoints for obtaining a BlockVectra API key via preferred programmatic SIWE sign-up or browser handoff, plus authentication header and URL formats for JSON-RPC and Data API.

tools.name: get_method_info
tools.description: Inspect a method's availability across chains (per methods.allow and methods.deny), Compute Unit (CU) weight, price per million calls, and documentation link. Sourced from /v1/chains, /v1/plans, and the documentation catalog.

tools.name: explain_error
tools.description: Lookup error code, reason, or HTTP status in the official error reference catalog. Returns meaning, billing implications (whether the call was billed), retryability, retry delay, recommended agent action, and documentation URL.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List all available documentation pages, relative paths, and titles from the static documentation index. No API key required.

tools.name: rpc_call
tools.description: Execute a JSON-RPC 2.0 method on a specified blockchain network using your BlockVectra API key. Requires the 'x-api-key' or 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' HTTP header in your MCP client configuration (never pass keys in tool parameters or chat). Returns the raw JSON-RPC response from the server.

tools.name: data_api_get
tools.description: Query the BlockVectra Data API for a specified chain and path using your BlockVectra API key. Requires the 'x-api-key' or 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' HTTP header in your MCP client configuration (never pass keys in tool parameters or chat). Returns the HTTP status and JSON response body.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
